name: L10 PanoLab track-carried lexical candidate ledger consumed Development
question: Does retaining target-name lexical candidates across a verified provider-adjacent sidestep increase the number of episodes that have both an available lexical candidate and a post-action authorized entrance ray, compared with discarding the pre-action observation and using the after frame alone?

observation_window.anchor: strict OSM entrance ray projected under the frozen zero-pose Panoramax contract
observation_window.sampling: native equirectangular pixels with horizontal seam wrap and no resampling
observation_window.ocr: frozen PP-OCRv6 medium detection and recognition ONNX

lexical_match.normalization: Unicode NFKD ASCII fold, lowercase alphanumeric tokens
lexical_match.exact_name_rule: All significant target-name tokens must occur contiguously in one OCR row.

two_initial_brand_signature.applicability: Only a target whose significant name is exactly two single-letter tokens.
two_initial_brand_signature.rule: At least two spatially distinct OCR rows must begin and end with the ordered target initials. This is a brand-signature candidate, not an exact transcription.

lexical_match.counterfactuals: Every one of the eight windows is also matched against the three other episode target names.

evidence_semantics.current_frame_only_baseline: Discard the start-frame lexical candidate and use only the after-action frame.
evidence_semantics.track_carried_successor: Retain a start-frame lexical candidate across the verified same-sequence reciprocal action edge and union it with any after-frame candidate.
evidence_semantics.component_separation: The lexical candidate and post-action entrance ray remain separate ledger entries. No lexical-to-portal or lexical-to-entrance ownership edge is emitted.
evidence_semantics.development_authority: The four-image-pair pixel cohort was already consumed and the window/matcher was chosen after exploratory Development inspection. This replay may demonstrate a mechanism effect but has no fresh or confirmation authority.

research_basis.title: RoadText-1K: Text Detection and Recognition Dataset for Driving Videos
research_basis.use: Motivates treating scene text in motion as a multi-frame observation problem. This evaluator carries discrete evidence; it does not implement the paper's models.

execution_rule: One output-bearing replay on the already-consumed four-episode Development cohort. Validate every frozen hash, all eight source image receipts, strict orientation, model files, runtime versions, and the prior active-ray gate before inference. Refuse overwrite.

claim_boundary.allowed: Consumed Development evidence that a component-separated track ledger retains more target-name lexical candidates alongside an independently authorized post-action entrance ray than an after-frame-only observation policy on these four episodes.
not_allowed: a lexical candidate being the target entity rather than a same-name sign or street label
entrance affordance, public access, walkability, or traversability
waypoint accuracy, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, user benefit, deployment performance, or safety
